description: Reads sixteen values carried on one polyphonic cable at addresses given by another, one read per address channel

inputs.text: Addresses the values, 10/16V per step over 0-10V and wrapping around outside that range, with one read per channel
Carries the sixteen values that are read, one value per channel

outputs.text: The value read for each channel of the address input
A 1ms trigger on a channel whenever the value read on that channel changes

notes: the module has no knobs: the sixteen values come from the CV input, and the output carries one channel per channel of the address input, so both have to be patched
